description: This file defines the ListViewDataEmails class, which extends ListViewData and manages email list view data retrieval, filtering, and query generation for the SuiteCRM Emails module. It includes methods for handling email headers, filtering emails based on search parameters, and integrating with different search modes (CRM and IMAP).

classes.name: ListViewDataEmails
classes.description: Represents email list view data, provides methods for filtering, querying, and processing email records for display in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: getInboundEmail
methods.description: Retrieves and validates the InboundEmail bean based on user preferences and folder settings.

methods.name: getSearchType
methods.description: Determines the search type ('crm' or 'imap') based on folder type.

methods.name: setInboundEmailMailbox
methods.description: Sets the mailbox property of InboundEmail based on folder type.

methods.name: getFilter
methods.description: Generates filtering criteria based on search fields and request parameters, and adjusts search type.

methods.name: fixFieldsInFilter
methods.description: Adjusts filter fields and SQL WHERE clause for email text fields to ensure proper filtering.

methods.name: getCrmQueryArray
methods.description: Builds a CRM query array with inner joins for email records.

methods.name: getCrmEmailsQuery
methods.description: Constructs the full CRM email query string incorporating custom parameters.

methods.name: getEmailHeaderStatus
methods.description: Returns email header status such as 'replied', 'draft', 'read', or 'unread'.

methods.name: getEmailRecordFieldValue
methods.description: Retrieves specific field values for an email record, such as sender, date, attachments, etc.

methods.name: getEmailRecord
methods.description: Builds a complete email record array from header information and folder context.

methods.name: isRequestedSearchAdvanced
methods.description: Checks if the current request is an advanced search.

methods.name: isRequestedSearchBasic
methods.description: Checks if the current request is a basic search.

methods.name: getEmailUIds
methods.description: Extracts UID list from given email data.

methods.name: getListViewData
methods.description: Main method to fetch list view data considering folder, filtering, and search type (CRM or IMAP). Invokes specific search classes accordingly.

methods.name: callGenerateQueries
methods.description: Wrapper to generate SQL queries for listing emails.

methods.name: callGenerateURLS
methods.description: Wrapper to generate URLs for listing email view pages.
